MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Motor Response.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Motor Response.

MotorResponseID.description: Unique identifier of this Motor Response instance.

MotorResponseTime.description: Time this Motor Response was produced.

MotorResponseSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Motor Response applies.

MotorID.description: Identifier of the motor producing this response.

MotorState.description: Operational state of the motor (e.g., active, idle, derated, fault).

AchievedTorque.description: Torque actually delivered by the motor (N·m).

AchievedPosition.description: Shaft or steering position measured at response time (radians or degrees).

MotorTemperature.description: Temperature of motor windings or housing (°C).

CurrentDraw.description: Electrical current drawn by the motor at response time (A).

DeratingActive.description: Indicates whether thermal or current derating mode is active.

AnomalyFlags.description: Set of flags indicating detected anomalies.

Overload.description: Indicates the motor is in an overload condition.

ThermalWarning.description: Indicates a thermal warning has been triggered.

UnexpectedBehavior.description: Indicates deviation from expected motor behavior.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Motor Response in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Motor Response (plain text, max 2048 characters).
